<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/application/{applicationId}/machines"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists Active and Limited machine assignments for the selected SELF application owned by the
authenticated client. The limit counts machines, not subscription groups. Merge groups with
the same subscription ID while traversing pages. Continuation tokens are opaque and valid only
for the same caller and application. Results are live reads, not a snapshot.
